import io,unittest
from types import SimpleNamespace

from cedar import profiles
class Adapter:
 def __init__(self,items):self.items=list(items);self.calls=[]
 def request(self,method,url,**kwargs):
  self.calls.append((method,url,kwargs));item=self.items.pop(0)
  if isinstance(item,Exception):raise item
  return SimpleNamespace(status=item[0],location=item[1] if len(item)>1 else None,headers=item[2] if len(item)>2 else {})

 def test_contract(self):
